sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 421)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and syndicated jungle adventure archives, four distinct eras of *Tarzan* spanning James H. Pierce in *The Diamond of the Great Temple* (1933) to Lamont Johnson solving jungle murders, rogue poachers, and leopard cults on *Tarzan, Lord of the Jungle* (1951–1952), Tennessee Ernie Ford on *The Ford Road Show* for Ford Motor Company (1958), and Joe Martin and Al Lamm's country guitar duets (1933–1964):
